description: CMS-authored page metadata and ordered content blocks for the SoloToChina frontend.
title: SoloToChina CMS Page Payload

contentType.description: Taxonomy, not layout. It must never cause the frontend to inject editorial blocks.

oneOf.title: Paragraph
oneOf.description: Standard editable body copy with meaningful inline links.

oneOf.title: Heading
oneOf.description: Creates an article section in the semantic document outline.

oneOf.title: List
oneOf.description: Presents related items or a meaningful sequence.

oneOf.title: Responsive Image
oneOf.description: Renders WordPress Media with intrinsic dimensions and responsive candidates.

oneOf.title: Quick Answer
oneOf.description: Places a direct answer before supporting detail for fast human and search scanning.

oneOf.title: Key Takeaways
oneOf.description: Summarizes the decisions that matter most.

oneOf.title: Quick Facts
oneOf.description: Shows practical label and value pairs without dashboard styling.

oneOf.title: Tip
oneOf.description: Highlights friendly supporting advice with low urgency.

oneOf.title: Warning
oneOf.description: Highlights a travel risk, prerequisite, or failure condition.

oneOf.title: Steps
oneOf.description: Explains an ordered setup, booking, or route process.

oneOf.title: Checklist
oneOf.description: Provides a scannable preparation list without saved completion state.

oneOf.title: Comparison Table
oneOf.description: Compares options with native table semantics and local mobile scrolling.

oneOf.title: FAQ
oneOf.description: Presents explicit questions and complete answers through native disclosures.

oneOf.title: Planner CTA
oneOf.description: Offers a contextual trip-planning action selected by the CMS.

oneOf.title: Ticket Reminder
oneOf.description: Delegates attraction timing and reminder behavior to SoloToChina Tools.

oneOf.title: Affiliate CTA
oneOf.description: Renders a restrained contextual commercial action with visible disclosure.

oneOf.title: Affiliate Booking Card
oneOf.description: Renders a CMS-selected high-intent Trip.com deep or category link after QA.

oneOf.title: Affiliate Search Card
oneOf.description: Renders a CMS-selected Trip.com search link or allowlisted structured search box.

oneOf.title: Affiliate Banner
oneOf.description: Renders a CMS-selected static or allowlisted dynamic Trip.com banner as a restrained fallback.

oneOf.title: Affiliate Promotion Card
oneOf.description: Renders a time-bounded CMS-selected Trip.com promotion without changing editorial conclusions.

blocks.description: Array order is the final render order. The frontend must not reorder or inject editorial blocks based on contentType.
